leads.name: Metrosideros at Campo de Sao Francisco
leads.reason: OSM node 3106113528 named Metrosidero in the square; komoot says planted over 150 years ago, branches held by steel props; a Tripadvisor summary gave 7.6 m girth, 18 m height but the page would not fetch. No official source read. Needs a register or council source for age and size.

leads.name: Dragoeiro, Rua Coronel Silva Leal
leads.reason: OSM node 13162961526 only; lifecheck NONE; no source for age or access (street or private plot not known).

leads.name: Norfolk Island pine, Rua Antonio Borges
leads.reason: OSM node 12025325543 next to Jardim Antonio Borges; SIARAM names a majestic Norfolk pine near the small lake inside the garden, not confirmed as the same trunk.

leads.name: Ficus macrophylla inside Jardim Jose do Canto
leads.reason: OSM nodes 12020707815 and 12020707823; inventory says monumental Ficus, Agathis and Araucaria bidwillii there (europeangardens.eu summary only, PDF would not fetch). Needs the SIARAM tree list and the garden's entry terms.

leads.name: Jardim Duque da Terceira araucarias, Angra do Heroismo (Terceira)
leads.reason: Municipal guide and SIARAM say centenary araucarias from the 1882 opening; no individual tree, age or coordinate found. Terceira is about 40 minutes by plane from Sao Miguel.

leads.name: Four dragon trees of Lugar da Praia, Água de Alto (Vila Franca do Campo)
leads.reason: Register SMG_IIM_38 to 41 (classified 1982, DRR 8/82/A), pins approximate, register flags 'may no longer exist'. Evidence conflicts on survival: a 2016 Correio dos Acores column (Terra Livre blog) says all four died in the late 1980s; a Governo dos Acores SIARAM report on the Ribeira da Praia says three dragon trees survive in the grounds of the Hotel Bahia Palace (now Pestana Bahia Praia), two of them marked as classified; iNaturalist Dracaena draco 2026-05-01 (id 357291096, accuracy 2 m) at 37.714655,-25.468533 confirms one alive. They stand in hotel grounds (OSM access=customers on the chapel and pool nearby). No public viewing point found, so it fails hard rule 10 for now. Would ship as a view-only ensemble if a public street or beach path with a sightline is found; fetch pin from the iNat fix.

leads.name: Dragon tree at Escola Secundária Antero de Quental, Ponta Delgada
leads.reason: Terra Livre 2016 (quoting engineer Ernesto Goes) calls it the largest dragon tree of São Miguel, said to date from the old Paço begun in 1587 (unverified claim). School grounds: no evidence they are open (rule 10); no coordinate; not classified. Three more dragon trees in Jardim António Borges per the same text, not individually located.

leads.name: Metrosideros of the Jardim do Palácio de Santana, Ponta Delgada
leads.reason: Em Defesa das Plantas dos Açores (2021) gives about 170 years, 24 m tall, crown 37 m, a favoured wedding-photo tree. Palace garden of the regional government: no source read on public opening; no coordinate; single blog source.

notes: No individual-tree register for the Azores found: DRRF's RRAIPA was created by DRR 2/2026/A (6 March 2026) and its list was not reachable (drrf.azores.gov.pt 403 to WebFetch); a 2022 news item cited 58 classified trees, 37 Faial, 14 Terceira, 7 Sao Miguel, not seen. Overpass hangs from this runner (overpass-api.de and kumi both time out); Nominatim worked. | 2026-11-02 São Miguel pass: delivered azo_004 to azo_007 in data/research/azores-sm-verified.json; Furnas pine, Campo de São Francisco pohutukawa, Mata-Jardim José do Canto sequoia, Jardim António Borges Norfolk pine. Campo de São Francisco lead above is now azo_004. The Jardim José do Canto (Ponta Delgada) Ficus and Rua Coronel Silva Leal dragon tree remain unverified (not reached).
